The phase portrait for a system of linear differential equations whose matrix has two real, distinct eigenvalues is shown above. The eigenvalues of the system's matrix are ${\lambda }_{1}$ and ${\lambda }_{2},$ for which the corresponding eigenvectors are ${v}_{1}=[-1,2]^{T}$ and ${v}_{2}=[1,2]^{T},$ respectively. Select the correct options in the reasoning below. The line that passes through the origin and is parallel to ${v}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 2\end{aligned}]$ has the equation
